title: The reader's extras throw for xlsb, xls and ods, and an ods cell's text ignores the file's number style.
text: Closing it reads `links`, `notes`, `names`, `tables` and `images` from xlsb, xls and ods and `properties` from xls and ods in `read/extras.rs`, and renders an ods cell under its own number style in `read/ods.rs` (`rule:core-classes/spreadsheet-reads-as-a-stream`).
